name: avior
description: A skill for building websites with Avior, an open source design system for React and Rsbuild where variables, helpers and components make every site look like its own content.

defaultPrompt: Create a landing page for my bakery with Avior: a hero, three feature cards and a contact section.
Retune my Avior site with a warm palette and a new font, changing only the variables.
Add a documentation page to my Avior site and register its route and sitemap entry.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: skill for building sites with Avior.
